1	# Protocol C: bounded, read-only host-side scoping (1bf)
2	
3	**Target.** Repository `REPO` = the `origin` of TARGET-FACTS; commit `e4724a44…3093`; t = 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z; window W = [2026-08-03T00:00Z, 2026-08-06T00:00Z). Scoping only: existence and metadata. No interpretation, and no evidence acquisition beyond derived counts. Script: `scope_c.sh OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR`.
4	
5	## 1. Channels (GET only; `{r}` = `repos/REPO`)
6	
7	| # | Channel | Endpoint | Why it is in the set |
8	|---|---|---|---|
9	| 0 | mode probe | `rate_limit` | Chooses gh or curl mode. Does not count against the host quota. |
10	| 1 | repository | `{r}` | Visibility decides which mode can reach anything else. Also gives owner type and the owner relation. |
11	| 2 | commit | `{r}/commits/{sha}` | Source of the host's mapping from git e-mail to account. Without it there are no role relations. |
12	| 3 | prs | `{r}/commits/{sha}/pulls?per_page=5`, then `{r}/pulls/{n}` | GitHub's own commit→PR association, plus `merged_at` and `merged_by` |
13	| 4 | reviews | `{r}/pulls/{n}/reviews?per_page=100` | Host-timestamped approvals, the nearest host analogue of an "authorization act" |
14	| 5 | timeline | `{r}/issues/{n}/timeline?per_page=100` | Review, merge, close, force-push and ready-for-review events |
15	| 6 | checks | `{r}/commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100` | Records of CI execution on the commit |
16	| 7 | status | `{r}/commits/{sha}/status` | Combined legacy statuses |
17	| 8 | runs | `{r}/actions/runs?head_sha={sha}&per_page=100` | Actions runs; the host generates their timestamps |
18	| 9 | protection | `{r}/branches/{base}/protection` | Branch rules on the base branch |
19	| 10 | branch_rules | `{r}/rules/branches/{base}` | Active ruleset rules on the base branch |
20	| 11 | rulesets | `{r}/rulesets?includes_parents=true` | Ruleset `created_at`/`updated_at` |
21	| 12 | events | `{r}/events?per_page=100&page=1..3` | Repository activity in W |
22	
23	**Left out:** search, other commits, logs and artifacts (that would be evidence acquisition, not scoping), audit log (organisation-only, needs admin), and everything under `docs/knowledgeos/` (R-SELF P-SELF; never a candidate channel). **Channels 9–11 return current state only. Historic state is not available from these endpoints**, so they cannot show what was in force at t. (Assumption to check, not called: a ruleset-history endpoint may exist. It is outside this frozen scope.) **Events retention (assumption to check, not fact):** the Events API is assumed to keep ≤ 90 days and ≤ 300 events. At about 58 days the window may be inside the 90 days but beyond the 300-event cap.
24	
25	## 2. Rules per channel
26	
27	**Existence**, the same for every channel:
28	- HTTP 200 with ≥ 1 relevant item → `EXISTS`.
29	- HTTP 200 with 0 items → `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST`.
30	- 401, 403, 404, other codes, transport failure, or not called → `NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, with the reason in `note`.
31	
32	There are three special cases:
33	- **protection:** a 404 with message `Branch not protected` → `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST`.
34	- **No associated PR:** reviews, timeline and the base-branch channels → `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST`, with the note "not called".
35	- **events:** `NOT_RETAINED` when the returned list does not reach back before W's start (oldest `created_at` ≥ 2026-08-03) and nothing in W was returned. If items in W were returned but coverage is incomplete → `EXISTS`, with `window_covered=false`.
36	
37	**Timestamp generator, per field:**
38	
39	| Channel | HOST_GENERATED | CLIENT_SUPPLIED | NOT_DETERMINABLE |
40	|---|---|---|---|
41	| repository | `created_at` | | |
42	| commit | | author/committer dates | |
43	| prs | `created_at`, `merged_at`, `closed_at` | | |
44	| reviews | `submitted_at` | | |
45	| timeline | event `created_at` | `committed` events (git dates) | |
46	| checks | `started_at`/`completed_at` only if every run belongs to the `github-actions` app | | otherwise (app-written through the Checks API) |
47	| status | `created_at` (assigned when the status is posted) | | |
48	| runs | `created_at`, `run_started_at` | `head_commit.timestamp` | |
49	| rulesets | `created_at`, `updated_at` | | |
50	| protection, branch_rules | | | no timestamps at all |
51	| events | `created_at` | | |
52	
53	**Norm state at t: `NOT_DETERMINABLE` for every channel.**
54	- A check-run or workflow run says that code was tested, not that the work was permitted.
55	- A review approves a merge of a diff, not the WP-4C-1 work. The derived `n_approvals_le_t` is only a pointer for the human.
56	- Protection, branch rules and rulesets are current-state only. Rules that govern merging are not the norm that permits the work.
57	- Rulesets `updated_le_t=true` would at most suggest the ruleset body is unchanged since before t. It is recorded, not interpreted.
58	
59	**Independence:** `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE` by default, never a forced negative. A channel's writers (the host, apps, reviewers) are not classed as executors by construction. A host timestamp alone does not make a record independent.
60	
61	## 3. Identity policy
62	
63	- OUT contains no logins, names, e-mails, avatars, profile URLs, numeric user ids or the owner slug. The repository appears as `REPO` in endpoints, and as `repo_slug_sha256` in the summary.
64	- Roles are held only in shell memory and in the temp dir:
65	  - commit author's mapped account (`commit.author`);
66	  - PR author;
67	  - merger;
68	  - reviewers;
69	  - run actor and triggering actor;
70	  - status creator;
71	  - event actor;
72	  - repository owner.
73	- Output is equality relations only, as `true`/`false` or counts:
74	  - `pr_author_eq_commit_author`, `merger_eq_pr_author`, `merger_eq_commit_author`;
75	  - `n_distinct_reviewers`, `n_approvals_by_pr_author`, `n_approvals_by_commit_author`;
76	  - `author_eq_committer`, `owner_eq_commit_author`;
77	  - `n_actor_eq_commit_author`, `n_triggering_actor_eq_commit_author`, `n_creator_eq_commit_author`;
78	  - `n_in_window_actor_eq_commit_author`.
79	- If GitHub has no e-mail→login mapping for the commit (`author` is null), every relation involving the commit author is `NOT_DETERMINABLE` and `identity_mapping_available=false`.
80	
81	## 4. Bound enforcement
82	
83	- **Repository and commit:** hard-coded, so neither can be overridden.
84	- **PRs:** at most 5, the lowest numbers first. `cap_reached` is recorded.
85	- **Base branch:** one, taken from the lowest-numbered PR. `n_distinct_bases` is recorded.
86	- **Window:** a fixed constant, applied as a filter. Nothing outside it is interpreted.
87	- **Call budget:** ≤ 40, counted in `get()`. Each call is refused once N = 40, and the script exits 4 with partial output; skipped channels are marked "not called: call budget reached". The planned maximum is 29 calls: 2 probes, 1 repo, 1 commit, 1 PR list, 15 per-PR, 3 commit-CI, 3 base, 3 events.
88	- **Pagination:** one page everywhere, with `*_truncated` flags when 100 items come back. The only exception is events: up to 3 pages, and it stops as soon as a page is short or the window start is reached.
89	- **Methods:** GET only, via `gh api -X GET` or `curl -sS -X GET`. No mutating `gh` subcommand is used.
90	
91	**Unauthenticated fallback:** this mode is used if `gh` is missing or its token is invalid, as it is now per ENVIRONMENT. It works only if the repository is public. Its declared coverage loss:
92	- the rate limit is 60/h;
93	- protection needs admin, so expect `NOT_ACCESSIBLE`;
94	- rulesets may be partly hidden.
95	
96	The `summary.json` field `coverage` declares the mode. If the repository GET is not 200, no further calls are made and every channel is marked `NOT_ACCESSIBLE`.
97	
98	**Paths:**
99	- The script resolves its own path before any `cd`.
100	- It refuses an OUT that already exists, that lies under WORKTREE_DIR, or that lies in any git work tree. It applies the same refusal to its temp dir.
101	- No `set -e`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 precondition, 3 refused path, 4 budget hit, 5 identity guard failed, 6 write failure.
102	- `LC_ALL=C`, `TZ=UTC`, deterministic sort.
103	- Raw responses live only in `mktemp -d …/scope_c.XXXXXXXX`. Removal (`rm -rf`) is limited to that directory, and its basename is checked first.
104	
105	## 5. Output (OUT)
106	
107	| File | Contents |
108	|---|---|
109	| `calls.tsv` | seq, channel, endpoint (with `REPO`), HTTP status, for every call |
110	| `channels.tsv` | One row per channel: http, existence, ts_generator, norm_state_at_t, independence, note |
111	| `ch_<channel>.tsv` | Derived key/value pairs |
112	| `prs.tsv`, `timeline.tsv`, `rulesets.tsv` | Derived rows, one per PR, event type or ruleset |
113	| `summary.json` | Mode, coverage, call count, budget, `budget_hit`, window, t, `script_sha256`, `repo_slug_sha256`, and `channels.tsv` as objects |
114	| `SHA256SUMS` | Hashes of all the files above |
115	
116	**Identity guard (fail closed).** OUT is first built in the temp dir. Before anything is copied, that staged copy is grepped for:
117	- `@`, `login`, `avatar_url`, `html_url` and `name"`;
118	- every login, git author name and git committer name seen in the raw responses, plus the owner slug, matched as whole words.
119	
120	Any hit → exit 5 and nothing is written to OUT. The guard runs again on OUT after the copy, followed by `sha256sum -c`.
121	
122	**Next steps per PREREG:** review → FAIL repair loop → main-analyst safety check → human re-authenticates `gh` (or accepts the declared unauthenticated loss) → run → output review → seal → information-gain review → human gate.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scope_c.sh: Protocol C (PROTOCOL-C.md). Bounded, read-only (HTTP GET only) host-side scoping of one commit.
3	# Raw responses stay in a private temp dir; only identity-free derived fields reach OUT.
4	# Usage: scope_c.sh OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR
5	# Exit: 0 ok | 2 precondition | 3 refused path | 4 budget hit (partial output) | 5 identity guard | 6 write failure
6	SELF="$(readlink -f -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" || exit 2   # resolved before any cd
7	export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC; umask 077
8	REPO="dr-roshyara/nrna1"; SHA="e4724a444231681f1a455ffaeea488a554183093"
9	T0="2026-08-04T00:30:25Z"; WF="2026-08-03T00:00:00Z"; WE="2026-08-06T00:00:00Z"
10	BUDGET=40; PR_CAP=5; EV_PAGES=3; API="https://api.github.com"
11	CHANNELS="commit prs reviews timeline checks status runs protection branch_rules rulesets events"
12	
13	[ $# -eq 2 ] || { echo "usage: ${SELF##*/} OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
14	for t in jq curl sha256sum readlink mktemp awk grep cut wc; do
15	  command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "refused: '$t' not found" >&2; exit 2; }; done
16	WTREE="$(readlink -f -- "$2")"
17	[ -n "$WTREE" ] && [ -d "$WTREE" ] || { echo "refused: WORKTREE_DIR is not a directory" >&2; exit 2; }
18	OUT="$(readlink -m -- "$1")"
19	inside() {   # PATH under WORKTREE_DIR, or its nearest existing ancestor inside any git work tree
20	  case "$1/" in "$WTREE"/*) return 0 ;; esac
21	  local a="$1"; while [ ! -d "$a" ]; do a="${a%/*}"; [ -n "$a" ] || a=/; done
22	  command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git -C "$a" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; }
23	[ -e "$OUT" ] && { echo "refused: OUT exists (no overwrite)" >&2; exit 3; }
24	inside "$OUT" && { echo "refused: OUT is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
25	TMP="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scope_c.XXXXXXXX")" || exit 6
26	cleanup() { case "${TMP##*/}" in scope_c.????????) [ -d "$TMP" ] && rm -rf -- "$TMP" ;; esac; }
27	trap cleanup EXIT
28	inside "$TMP" && { echo "refused: TMPDIR is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
29	R="$TMP/raw"; S="$TMP/stage"; mkdir "$R" "$S" || exit 6
30	
31	N=0; HIT=0; MODE=curl
32	printf 'seq\tchannel\tendpoint\thttp_status\n' > "$S/calls.tsv"
33	get() {   # get KEY CHANNEL PATH: one GET -> $R/KEY.json + $R/KEY.status; returns 1 once the budget is spent
34	  local k="$1" p="$3" s="" h=(-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28")
35	  if [ "$N" -ge "$BUDGET" ]; then HIT=1; echo 000 > "$R/$k.status"; echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"; return 1; fi
36	  N=$((N + 1))
37	  if [ "$MODE" = gh ]; then
38	    gh api -X GET -i "${h[@]}" "$p" > "$R/$k.http" 2>/dev/null
39	    s="$(head -n1 "$R/$k.http" | awk '{print $2}')"; awk 'b{print; next} /^\r?$/{b=1}' "$R/$k.http" > "$R/$k.json"
40	  else s="$(curl -sS -X GET -o "$R/$k.json" -w '%{http_code}' "${h[@]}" "$API/$p" 2>/dev/null)"; fi
41	  echo "${s:-000}" > "$R/$k.status"
42	  jq -e . "$R/$k.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"
43	  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$N" "$2" "${p//"$REPO"/REPO}" "${s:-000}" >> "$S/calls.tsv"; }
44	st() { cat "$R/$1.status" 2>/dev/null || echo 000; }
45	agg() { local s; for s in ${1//,/ }; do [ "$s" = 200 ] || { echo "$s"; return; }; done; echo 200; }
46	exist() { if [ "$1" != 200 ]; then echo NOT_ACCESSIBLE
47	  elif [ "${2:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo EXISTS; else echo NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST; fi; }
48	printf 'channel\thttp\texistence\tts_generator\tnorm_state_at_t\tindependence\tnote\n' > "$S/channels.tsv"
49	row() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\tNOT_DETERMINABLE\tINDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE\t%s\n' "$@" >> "$S/channels.tsv"; }
50	kv() { local f="$S/ch_$1.tsv"; [ -e "$f" ] || printf 'key\tvalue\n' > "$f"; cat >> "$f"; }
51	kvget() { awk -F'\t' -v k="$2" '$1==k{print $2}' "$S/ch_$1.tsv" 2>/dev/null; }
52	JQD='def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
53	def inw: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x >= $wf and $x < $we;
54	def le_t: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x <= $t;
55	def eq(a; b): if (a // "") == "" or (b // "") == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" elif a == b then "true" else "false" end;
56	def cnt(f): if $ca == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else (map(select(f == $ca)) | length) end;
57	def tally(f): map(f // "none" | tostring) | group_by(.) | map("\(.[0])=\(length)") | join(",");'
58	jqn() { local f="$1"; shift   # jqn FILTER [jq options]; $ca/$pa (roles) live only in memory
59	  jq -nr --arg ca "${CA:-}" --arg pa "${PA:-}" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" "$@" "$JQD $f"; }
60	
61	scan() {
62	  get commit commit "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA" || return
63	  CA="$(jq -r '.author.login // empty' "$R/commit.json")"
64	  jqn '$x[0] | "identity_mapping_available\t\($ca != "")", "author_eq_committer\t\(eq(.author.login; .committer.login))",
65	    "author_date\t\(.commit.author.date // "")", "committer_date\t\(.commit.committer.date // "")",
66	    "signature_verified\t\(.commit.verification.verified | tostring)",
67	    "verification_reason\t\(.commit.verification.reason // "none")"' --slurpfile x "$R/commit.json" | kv commit
68	  row commit "$(st commit)" "$(exist "$(st commit)" 1)" "author.date,committer.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "role mapping source only"
69	  jqn '$x[0] | "owner_eq_commit_author\t\(eq(.owner.login; $ca))"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository
70	
71	  get pulls prs "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/pulls?per_page=$PR_CAP" || return
72	  mapfile -t PRS < <(jqn "\$x[0] | arr | map(.number) | sort | .[:$PR_CAP][]" --slurpfile x "$R/pulls.json")
73	  local npr=${#PRS[@]} n rv="" tl="" nrv ntl
74	  row prs "$(st pulls)" "$(exist "$(st pulls)" "$npr")" "created_at,merged_at=HOST_GENERATED" "n=$npr; cap_reached=$([ "$npr" -ge "$PR_CAP" ] && echo true || echo false)"
75	  printf 'pr\tstate\tmerged\tbase_ref\tcreated_at\tmerged_at\tmerged_le_t\tmerged_in_window\tpr_author_eq_commit_author\tmerger_eq_pr_author\tmerger_eq_commit_author\tn_reviews\tn_distinct_reviewers\tn_approvals\tn_approvals_le_t\tn_approvals_in_window\tn_approvals_by_pr_author\tn_approvals_by_commit_author\treviews_truncated\ttimeline_truncated\n' > "$S/prs.tsv"
76	  printf 'pr\tevent\tn\tn_in_window\tts_generator\n' > "$S/timeline.tsv"
77	  for n in "${PRS[@]}"; do
78	    get "pr$n" prs "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n" || break
79	    get "rv$n" reviews "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n/reviews?per_page=100" || break
80	    get "tl$n" timeline "repos/$REPO/issues/$n/timeline?per_page=100" || break
81	    rv="$rv${rv:+,}$(st "rv$n")"; tl="$tl${tl:+,}$(st "tl$n")"; PA="$(jq -r '.user.login // empty' "$R/pr$n.json")"
82	    jqn '($p[0]) as $p | ($v[0] | arr) as $v | ($l[0] | arr) as $l | ($v | map(select(.state == "APPROVED"))) as $a |
83	      [$p.number, $p.state, ($p.merged_at != null), ($p.base.ref // ""), $p.created_at, ($p.merged_at // ""),
84	       ($p.merged_at | le_t), ($p.merged_at | inw), eq($pa; $ca), eq($p.merged_by.login; $pa), eq($p.merged_by.login; $ca),
85	       ($v | length), ($v | map(.user.login) | unique | length), ($a | length),
86	       ($a | map(select(.submitted_at | le_t)) | length), ($a | map(select(.submitted_at | inw)) | length),
87	       (if $pa == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else ($a | map(select(.user.login == $pa)) | length) end),
88	       ($a | cnt(.user.login)), (($v | length) >= 100), (($l | length) >= 100)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' \
89	      --slurpfile p "$R/pr$n.json" --slurpfile v "$R/rv$n.json" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/prs.tsv"
90	    jqn '$l[0] | arr | group_by(.event) | .[] | .[0].event as $e | [$n, $e, length,
91	       (map(.created_at // .submitted_at // .author.date | inw) | map(select(.)) | length),
92	       (if $e == "committed" then "author.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" elif $e == "reviewed" then "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED"
93	        else "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" end)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --arg n "$n" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/timeline.tsv"
94	  done
95	  PA=""; nrv="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$12} END{print s+0}' "$S/prs.tsv")"; ntl="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$3} END{print s+0}' "$S/timeline.tsv")"
96	  if [ "$npr" -eq 0 ]; then
97	    row reviews - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "not called: no associated PR"
98	    row timeline - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST "created_at=HOST_GENERATED; committed=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "not called: no associated PR"
99	  elif [ -n "$rv" ]; then
100	    row reviews "$rv" "$(exist "$(agg "$rv")" "$nrv")" "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "n=$nrv; see prs.tsv"
101	    row timeline "$tl" "$(exist "$(agg "$tl")" "$ntl")" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED; committed=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "n=$ntl; see timeline.tsv"
102	  fi
103	  [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && return
104	
105	  get checks checks "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/check-runs?per_page=100" || return
106	  jqn '($x[0].check_runs | arr) as $r | "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
107	    "n_app_github_actions\t\($r | map(select(.app.slug == "github-actions")) | length)",
108	    "n_started_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | le_t)) | length)",
109	    "n_started_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | inw)) | length)", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))"' \
110	    --slurpfile x "$R/checks.json" | kv checks
111	  local nc g=NOT_DETERMINABLE; nc="$(kvget checks n_returned)"
112	  [ "${nc:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ "$nc" = "$(kvget checks n_app_github_actions)" ] && g=HOST_GENERATED
113	  row checks "$(st checks)" "$(exist "$(st checks)" "$nc")" "started_at,completed_at=$g" "app-written; HOST only if all by GitHub Actions"
114	
115	  get status status "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/status" || return
116	  jqn '($x[0].statuses | arr) as $r | "state\t\($x[0].state // "none")", "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)",
117	    "n_created_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | le_t)) | length)", "n_created_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | inw)) | length)",
118	    "n_creator_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.creator.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/status.json" | kv status
119	  row status "$(st status)" "$(exist "$(st status)" "$(kvget status total_count)")" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "latest status per context only"
120	
121	  get runs runs "repos/$REPO/actions/runs?head_sha=$SHA&per_page=100" || return
122	  jqn '($x[0].workflow_runs | arr) as $r | "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
123	    "n_created_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | le_t)) | length)", "n_created_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | inw)) | length)",
124	    "events\t\($r | tally(.event))", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))", "n_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.actor.login))",
125	    "n_triggering_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.triggering_actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/runs.json" | kv runs
126	  row runs "$(st runs)" "$(exist "$(st runs)" "$(kvget runs total_count)")" "created_at,run_started_at=HOST_GENERATED; head_commit.timestamp=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "metadata only; logs not fetched"
127	
128	  local base nb b pe hist="current state only; historic state not available"
129	  base="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==2{print $4}' "$S/prs.tsv")"   # base branch of the lowest-numbered associated PR
130	  nb="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $4!=""{print $4}' "$S/prs.tsv" | sort -u | wc -l)"
131	  if [ -z "$base" ]; then
132	    for c in protection branch_rules rulesets; do row "$c" - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST NOT_DETERMINABLE "not called: no associated PR, no base branch"; done
133	  else
134	    b="$(jq -rn --arg b "$base" '$b | @uri')"
135	    get prot protection "repos/$REPO/branches/$b/protection" || return
136	    jqn '$x[0] | "scope\tCURRENT_STATE_ONLY", "n_distinct_bases\t'"$nb"'", "required_pull_request_reviews\t\(.required_pull_request_reviews != null)",
137	      "required_approving_review_count\t\(.required_pull_request_reviews.required_approving_review_count // 0)",
138	      "enforce_admins\t\(.enforce_admins.enabled // false)", "required_status_checks\t\(.required_status_checks != null)",
139	      "required_signatures\t\(.required_signatures.enabled // false)", "push_restrictions\t\(.restrictions != null)",
140	      "allow_force_pushes\t\(.allow_force_pushes.enabled // false)"' --slurpfile x "$R/prot.json" | kv protection
141	    pe="$(exist "$(st prot)" 1)"
142	    [ "$(st prot)" = 404 ] && [ "$(jq -r '.message? // ""' "$R/prot.json")" = "Branch not protected" ] && pe=NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST
143	    row protection "$(st prot)" "$pe" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$hist"
144	    get brules branch_rules "repos/$REPO/rules/branches/$b?per_page=100" || return
145	    jqn '$x[0] | arr | "scope\tCURRENT_STATE_ONLY", "n_active_rules\t\(length)", "types\t\(tally(.type))"' --slurpfile x "$R/brules.json" | kv branch_rules
146	    row branch_rules "$(st brules)" "$(exist "$(st brules)" "$(kvget branch_rules n_active_rules)")" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$hist"
147	    get rsets rulesets "repos/$REPO/rulesets?per_page=100&includes_parents=true" || return
148	    { printf 'id\ttarget\tenforcement\tcreated_at\tupdated_at\tupdated_le_t\n'
149	      jqn '$x[0] | arr | sort_by(.id) | .[] | [.id, .target, .enforcement, (.created_at // ""), (.updated_at // ""), (.updated_at | le_t)]
150	        | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --slurpfile x "$R/rsets.json"; } > "$S/rulesets.tsv"
151	    row rulesets "$(st rsets)" "$(exist "$(st rsets)" "$(($(wc -l < "$S/rulesets.tsv") - 1))")" "created_at,updated_at=HOST_GENERATED" "$hist"
152	  fi
153	
154	  local p c o nw ee
155	  for ((p = 1; p <= EV_PAGES; p++)); do   # page only while the window start has not been reached
156	    get "ev$p" events "repos/$REPO/events?per_page=100&page=$p" || break
157	    [ "$(st "ev$p")" = 200 ] || break
158	    c="$(jq 'if type == "array" then length else 0 end' "$R/ev$p.json")"; o="$(jq -r '[.[]?.created_at?] | min // ""' "$R/ev$p.json")"
159	    [ "$c" -lt 100 ] && break; [[ "$o" < "$WF" ]] && break
160	  done
161	  [ "$(st ev1)" = 000 ] && return
162	  jq -s '[.[] | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end]' "$R"/ev?.json > "$R/ev_all.json"
163	  jqn '($x[0] | arr) as $a | ($a | map(select(.created_at | inw))) as $w | ($a | map(.created_at) | min // "") as $o |
164	    "n_returned\t\($a | length)", "oldest_created_at\t\($o)", "newest_created_at\t\($a | map(.created_at) | max // "")",
165	    "window_covered\t\($o != "" and $o < $wf)", "n_in_window\t\($w | length)", "types_in_window\t\($w | tally(.type))",
166	    "n_in_window_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($w | cnt(.actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/ev_all.json" | kv events
167	  nw="$(kvget events n_in_window)"
168	  if [ "$(st ev1)" != 200 ]; then ee=NOT_ACCESSIBLE; elif [ "$(kvget events window_covered)" = true ]; then ee="$(exist 200 "$nw")"
169	  elif [ "${nw:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then ee=EXISTS; else ee=NOT_RETAINED; fi
170	  row events "$(st ev1)" "$ee" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "retention assumed <=90 days and <=300 events (unchecked)"
171	}
172	
173	if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE=gh; get probe_gh mode rate_limit; [ "$(st probe_gh)" = 200 ] || MODE=curl; fi
174	[ "$MODE" = curl ] && get probe_curl mode rate_limit
175	COVERAGE="authenticated (gh api)"
176	[ "$MODE" = curl ] && COVERAGE="UNAUTHENTICATED curl: public repo only, 60 calls/h; protection needs admin and is expected NOT_ACCESSIBLE"
177	get repo repository "repos/$REPO"
178	jqn '$x[0] | "visibility\t\(.visibility // (if .private == true then "private" elif .private == false then "public" else "unknown" end))",
179	  "owner_type\t\(.owner.type // "unknown")", "created_at\t\(.created_at // "")"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository
180	row repository "$(st repo)" "$(exist "$(st repo)" 1)" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "visibility=$(kvget repository visibility)"
181	if [ "$(st repo)" = 200 ]; then scan; WHY="call budget reached"; else WHY="repository GET returned $(st repo)"; fi
182	for c in $CHANNELS; do cut -f1 "$S/channels.tsv" | grep -qx "$c" || row "$c" - NOT_ACCESSIBLE NOT_DETERMINABLE "not called: $WHY"; done
183	
184	jq -Rn --arg mode "$MODE" --arg cov "$COVERAGE" --arg sha "$SHA" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" \
185	  --arg rh "$(printf %s "$REPO" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)" --arg sh "$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -c1-64)" \
186	  --argjson n "$N" --argjson bud "$BUDGET" --argjson hit "$HIT" \
187	  '[inputs | split("\t")] as $rows | {protocol: "C", mode: $mode, coverage: $cov, commit: $sha, repo_slug_sha256: $rh,
188	   script_sha256: $sh, t: $t, window: {from: $wf, to: $we}, calls: $n, budget: $bud, budget_hit: ($hit == 1),
189	   channels: ($rows[1:] | map([$rows[0], .] | transpose | map({(.[0]): .[1]}) | add))}' "$S/channels.tsv" > "$S/summary.json" || exit 6
190	( cd "$S" && sha256sum -- *.tsv summary.json > SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6
191	
192	# Identity guard, fail closed: fixed patterns plus every account handle and git author string seen in the raw data.
193	{ jq -r '.. | objects | (.login? // empty), (select(has("email")) | .name? // empty)' "$R"/*.json 2>/dev/null
194	  printf '%s\n' "${REPO%%/*}"; } | awk 'length >= 3' | sort -u > "$R/ids.txt"
195	guard() { ! grep -rIlE '@|login|avatar_url|html_url|name"' -- "$1" && ! grep -rIlwF -f "$R/ids.txt" -- "$1"; }
196	guard "$S" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED: nothing written to OUT" >&2; exit 5; }
197	mkdir -p -- "$OUT" && cp -- "$S"/* "$OUT"/ || exit 6
198	guard "$OUT" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED on OUT: quarantine $OUT by hand" >&2; exit 5; }
199	( cd "$OUT" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6
200	echo "mode=$MODE calls=$N/$BUDGET budget_hit=$HIT"
201	[ "$HIT" = 1 ] && exit 4
202	exit 0
203

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_c.sh: Protocol C (PROTOCOL-C.md). Bounded, read-only (HTTP GET only) host-side scoping of one commit.
# Raw responses stay in a private temp dir; only identity-free derived fields reach OUT.
# Usage: scope_c.sh OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR
# Exit: 0 ok | 2 precondition | 3 refused path | 4 budget hit (partial output) | 5 identity guard | 6 write failure
SELF="$(readlink -f -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" || exit 2   # resolved before any cd
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC; umask 077
REPO="dr-roshyara/nrna1"; SHA="e4724a444231681f1a455ffaeea488a554183093"
T0="2026-08-04T00:30:25Z"; WF="2026-08-03T00:00:00Z"; WE="2026-08-06T00:00:00Z"
BUDGET=40; PR_CAP=5; EV_PAGES=3; API="https://api.github.com"
CHANNELS="commit prs reviews timeline checks status runs protection branch_rules rulesets events"

[ $# -eq 2 ] || { echo "usage: ${SELF##*/} OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
for t in jq curl sha256sum readlink mktemp awk grep cut wc; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "refused: '$t' not found" >&2; exit 2; }; done
WTREE="$(readlink -f -- "$2")"
[ -n "$WTREE" ] && [ -d "$WTREE" ] || { echo "refused: WORKTREE_DIR is not a directory" >&2; exit 2; }
OUT="$(readlink -m -- "$1")"
inside() {   # PATH under WORKTREE_DIR, or its nearest existing ancestor inside any git work tree
  case "$1/" in "$WTREE"/*) return 0 ;; esac
  local a="$1"; while [ ! -d "$a" ]; do a="${a%/*}"; [ -n "$a" ] || a=/; done
  command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git -C "$a" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; }
[ -e "$OUT" ] && { echo "refused: OUT exists (no overwrite)" >&2; exit 3; }
inside "$OUT" && { echo "refused: OUT is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
TMP="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scope_c.XXXXXXXX")" || exit 6
cleanup() { case "${TMP##*/}" in scope_c.????????) [ -d "$TMP" ] && rm -rf -- "$TMP" ;; esac; }
trap cleanup EXIT
inside "$TMP" && { echo "refused: TMPDIR is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
R="$TMP/raw"; S="$TMP/stage"; mkdir "$R" "$S" || exit 6

N=0; HIT=0; MODE=curl
printf 'seq\tchannel\tendpoint\thttp_status\n' > "$S/calls.tsv"
get() {   # get KEY CHANNEL PATH: one GET -> $R/KEY.json + $R/KEY.status; returns 1 once the budget is spent
  local k="$1" p="$3" s="" h=(-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28")
  if [ "$N" -ge "$BUDGET" ]; then HIT=1; echo 000 > "$R/$k.status"; echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"; return 1; fi
  N=$((N + 1))
  if [ "$MODE" = gh ]; then
    gh api -X GET -i "${h[@]}" "$p" > "$R/$k.http" 2>/dev/null
    s="$(head -n1 "$R/$k.http" | awk '{print $2}')"; awk 'b{print; next} /^\r?$/{b=1}' "$R/$k.http" > "$R/$k.json"
  else s="$(curl -sS -X GET -o "$R/$k.json" -w '%{http_code}' "${h[@]}" "$API/$p" 2>/dev/null)"; fi
  echo "${s:-000}" > "$R/$k.status"
  jq -e . "$R/$k.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$N" "$2" "${p//"$REPO"/REPO}" "${s:-000}" >> "$S/calls.tsv"; }
st() { cat "$R/$1.status" 2>/dev/null || echo 000; }
agg() { local s; for s in ${1//,/ }; do [ "$s" = 200 ] || { echo "$s"; return; }; done; echo 200; }
exist() { if [ "$1" != 200 ]; then echo NOT_ACCESSIBLE
  elif [ "${2:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo EXISTS; else echo NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST; fi; }
printf 'channel\thttp\texistence\tts_generator\tnorm_state_at_t\tindependence\tnote\n' > "$S/channels.tsv"
row() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\tNOT_DETERMINABLE\tINDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE\t%s\n' "$@" >> "$S/channels.tsv"; }
kv() { local f="$S/ch_$1.tsv"; [ -e "$f" ] || printf 'key\tvalue\n' > "$f"; cat >> "$f"; }
kvget() { awk -F'\t' -v k="$2" '$1==k{print $2}' "$S/ch_$1.tsv" 2>/dev/null; }
JQD='def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
def inw: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x >= $wf and $x < $we;
def le_t: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x <= $t;
def eq(a; b): if (a // "") == "" or (b // "") == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" elif a == b then "true" else "false" end;
def cnt(f): if $ca == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else (map(select(f == $ca)) | length) end;
def tally(f): map(f // "none" | tostring) | group_by(.) | map("\(.[0])=\(length)") | join(",");'
jqn() { local f="$1"; shift   # jqn FILTER [jq options]; $ca/$pa (roles) live only in memory
  jq -nr --arg ca "${CA:-}" --arg pa "${PA:-}" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" "$@" "$JQD $f"; }

scan() {
  get commit commit "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA" || return
  CA="$(jq -r '.author.login // empty' "$R/commit.json")"
  jqn '$x[0] | "identity_mapping_available\t\($ca != "")", "author_eq_committer\t\(eq(.author.login; .committer.login))",
    "author_date\t\(.commit.author.date // "")", "committer_date\t\(.commit.committer.date // "")",
    "signature_verified\t\(.commit.verification.verified | tostring)",
    "verification_reason\t\(.commit.verification.reason // "none")"' --slurpfile x "$R/commit.json" | kv commit
  row commit "$(st commit)" "$(exist "$(st commit)" 1)" "author.date,committer.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "role mapping source only"
  jqn '$x[0] | "owner_eq_commit_author\t\(eq(.owner.login; $ca))"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository

  get pulls prs "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/pulls?per_page=$PR_CAP" || return
  mapfile -t PRS < <(jqn "\$x[0] | arr | map(.number) | sort | .[:$PR_CAP][]" --slurpfile x "$R/pulls.json")
  local npr=${#PRS[@]} n rv="" tl="" nrv ntl
  row prs "$(st pulls)" "$(exist "$(st pulls)" "$npr")" "created_at,merged_at=HOST_GENERATED" "n=$npr; cap_reached=$([ "$npr" -ge "$PR_CAP" ] && echo true || echo false)"
  printf 'pr\tstate\tmerged\tbase_ref\tcreated_at\tmerged_at\tmerged_le_t\tmerged_in_window\tpr_author_eq_commit_author\tmerger_eq_pr_author\tmerger_eq_commit_author\tn_reviews\tn_distinct_reviewers\tn_approvals\tn_approvals_le_t\tn_approvals_in_window\tn_approvals_by_pr_author\tn_approvals_by_commit_author\treviews_truncated\ttimeline_truncated\n' > "$S/prs.tsv"
  printf 'pr\tevent\tn\tn_in_window\tts_generator\n' > "$S/timeline.tsv"
  for n in "${PRS[@]}"; do
    get "pr$n" prs "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n" || break
    get "rv$n" reviews "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n/reviews?per_page=100" || break
    get "tl$n" timeline "repos/$REPO/issues/$n/timeline?per_page=100" || break
    rv="$rv${rv:+,}$(st "rv$n")"; tl="$tl${tl:+,}$(st "tl$n")"; PA="$(jq -r '.user.login // empty' "$R/pr$n.json")"
    jqn '($p[0]) as $p | ($v[0] | arr) as $v | ($l[0] | arr) as $l | ($v | map(select(.state == "APPROVED"))) as $a |
      [$p.number, $p.state, ($p.merged_at != null), ($p.base.ref // ""), $p.created_at, ($p.merged_at // ""),
       ($p.merged_at | le_t), ($p.merged_at | inw), eq($pa; $ca), eq($p.merged_by.login; $pa), eq($p.merged_by.login; $ca),
       ($v | length), ($v | map(.user.login) | unique | length), ($a | length),
       ($a | map(select(.submitted_at | le_t)) | length), ($a | map(select(.submitted_at | inw)) | length),
       (if $pa == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else ($a | map(select(.user.login == $pa)) | length) end),
       ($a | cnt(.user.login)), (($v | length) >= 100), (($l | length) >= 100)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' \
      --slurpfile p "$R/pr$n.json" --slurpfile v "$R/rv$n.json" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/prs.tsv"
    jqn '$l[0] | arr | group_by(.event) | .[] | .[0].event as $e | [$n, $e, length,
       (map(.created_at // .submitted_at // .author.date | inw) | map(select(.)) | length),
       (if $e == "committed" then "author.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" elif $e == "reviewed" then "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED"
        else "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" end)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --arg n "$n" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/timeline.tsv"
  done
  PA=""; nrv="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$12} END{print s+0}' "$S/prs.tsv")"; ntl="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$3} END{print s+0}' "$S/timeline.tsv")"
  if [ "$npr" -eq 0 ]; then
    row reviews - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "not called: no associated PR"
    row timeline - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST "created_at=HOST_GENERATED; committed=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "not called: no associated PR"
  elif [ -n "$rv" ]; then
    row reviews "$rv" "$(exist "$(agg "$rv")" "$nrv")" "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "n=$nrv; see prs.tsv"
    row timeline "$tl" "$(exist "$(agg "$tl")" "$ntl")" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED; committed=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "n=$ntl; see timeline.tsv"
  fi
  [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && return

  get checks checks "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/check-runs?per_page=100" || return
  jqn '($x[0].check_runs | arr) as $r | "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
    "n_app_github_actions\t\($r | map(select(.app.slug == "github-actions")) | length)",
    "n_started_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | le_t)) | length)",
    "n_started_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | inw)) | length)", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))"' \
    --slurpfile x "$R/checks.json" | kv checks
  local nc g=NOT_DETERMINABLE; nc="$(kvget checks n_returned)"
  [ "${nc:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ "$nc" = "$(kvget checks n_app_github_actions)" ] && g=HOST_GENERATED

  get status status "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/status" || return
  jqn '($x[0].statuses | arr) as $r | "state\t\($x[0].state // "none")", "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)",

    "n_creator_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.creator.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/status.json" | kv status
  row status "$(st status)" "$(exist "$(st status)" "$(kvget status total_count)")" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "latest status per context only"

  get runs runs "repos/$REPO/actions/runs?head_sha=$SHA&per_page=100" || return
  jqn '($x[0].workflow_runs | arr) as $r | "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
    "n_created_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | le_t)) | length)", "n_created_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | inw)) | length)",
    "events\t\($r | tally(.event))", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))", "n_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.actor.login))",
    "n_triggering_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.triggering_actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/runs.json" | kv runs
  row runs "$(st runs)" "$(exist "$(st runs)" "$(kvget runs total_count)")" "created_at,run_started_at=HOST_GENERATED; head_commit.timestamp=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "metadata only; logs not fetched"

  local base nb b pe hist="current state only; historic state not available"
  base="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==2{print $4}' "$S/prs.tsv")"   # base branch of the lowest-numbered associated PR
  nb="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $4!=""{print $4}' "$S/prs.tsv" | sort -u | wc -l)"

    for c in protection branch_rules rulesets; do row "$c" - NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST NOT_DETERMINABLE "not called: no associated PR, no base branch"; done

      "enforce_admins\t\(.enforce_admins.enabled // false)", "required_status_checks\t\(.required_status_checks != null)",
      "required_signatures\t\(.required_signatures.enabled // false)", "push_restrictions\t\(.restrictions != null)",
      "allow_force_pushes\t\(.allow_force_pushes.enabled // false)"' --slurpfile x "$R/prot.json" | kv protection
    pe="$(exist "$(st prot)" 1)"

    get brules branch_rules "repos/$REPO/rules/branches/$b?per_page=100" || return
    jqn '$x[0] | arr | "scope\tCURRENT_STATE_ONLY", "n_active_rules\t\(length)", "types\t\(tally(.type))"' --slurpfile x "$R/brules.json" | kv branch_rules
    row branch_rules "$(st brules)" "$(exist "$(st brules)" "$(kvget branch_rules n_active_rules)")" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$hist"
    get rsets rulesets "repos/$REPO/rulesets?per_page=100&includes_parents=true" || return
    { printf 'id\ttarget\tenforcement\tcreated_at\tupdated_at\tupdated_le_t\n'
      jqn '$x[0] | arr | sort_by(.id) | .[] | [.id, .target, .enforcement, (.created_at // ""), (.updated_at // ""), (.updated_at | le_t)]
        | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --slurpfile x "$R/rsets.json"; } > "$S/rulesets.tsv"
    row rulesets "$(st rsets)" "$(exist "$(st rsets)" "$(($(wc -l < "$S/rulesets.tsv") - 1))")" "created_at,updated_at=HOST_GENERATED" "$hist"
  fi

  local p c o nw ee
  for ((p = 1; p <= EV_PAGES; p++)); do   # page only while the window start has not been reached
    get "ev$p" events "repos/$REPO/events?per_page=100&page=$p" || break
    [ "$(st "ev$p")" = 200 ] || break
    c="$(jq 'if type == "array" then length else 0 end' "$R/ev$p.json")"; o="$(jq -r '[.[]?.created_at?] | min // ""' "$R/ev$p.json")"
    [ "$c" -lt 100 ] && break; [[ "$o" < "$WF" ]] && break
  done
  [ "$(st ev1)" = 000 ] && return
  jq -s '[.[] | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end]' "$R"/ev?.json > "$R/ev_all.json"
  jqn '($x[0] | arr) as $a | ($a | map(select(.created_at | inw))) as $w | ($a | map(.created_at) | min // "") as $o |
    "n_returned\t\($a | length)", "oldest_created_at\t\($o)", "newest_created_at\t\($a | map(.created_at) | max // "")",
    "window_covered\t\($o != "" and $o < $wf)", "n_in_window\t\($w | length)", "types_in_window\t\($w | tally(.type))",
    "n_in_window_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($w | cnt(.actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/ev_all.json" | kv events
  nw="$(kvget events n_in_window)"
  if [ "$(st ev1)" != 200 ]; then ee=NOT_ACCESSIBLE; elif [ "$(kvget events window_covered)" = true ]; then ee="$(exist 200 "$nw")"
  elif [ "${nw:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then ee=EXISTS; else ee=NOT_RETAINED; fi
  row events "$(st ev1)" "$ee" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "retention assumed <=90 days and <=300 events (unchecked)"
}

if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE=gh; get probe_gh mode rate_limit; [ "$(st probe_gh)" = 200 ] || MODE=curl; fi
[ "$MODE" = curl ] && get probe_curl mode rate_limit
COVERAGE="authenticated (gh api)"
[ "$MODE" = curl ] && COVERAGE="UNAUTHENTICATED curl: public repo only, 60 calls/h; protection needs admin and is expected NOT_ACCESSIBLE"
get repo repository "repos/$REPO"
jqn '$x[0] | "visibility\t\(.visibility // (if .private == true then "private" elif .private == false then "public" else "unknown" end))",
  "owner_type\t\(.owner.type // "unknown")", "created_at\t\(.created_at // "")"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository
row repository "$(st repo)" "$(exist "$(st repo)" 1)" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "visibility=$(kvget repository visibility)"
if [ "$(st repo)" = 200 ]; then scan; WHY="call budget reached"; else WHY="repository GET returned $(st repo)"; fi
for c in $CHANNELS; do cut -f1 "$S/channels.tsv" | grep -qx "$c" || row "$c" - NOT_ACCESSIBLE NOT_DETERMINABLE "not called: $WHY"; done

jq -Rn --arg mode "$MODE" --arg cov "$COVERAGE" --arg sha "$SHA" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" \
  --arg rh "$(printf %s "$REPO" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)" --arg sh "$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -c1-64)" \
  --argjson n "$N" --argjson bud "$BUDGET" --argjson hit "$HIT" \
  '[inputs | split("\t")] as $rows | {protocol: "C", mode: $mode, coverage: $cov, commit: $sha, repo_slug_sha256: $rh,
   script_sha256: $sh, t: $t, window: {from: $wf, to: $we}, calls: $n, budget: $bud, budget_hit: ($hit == 1),
   channels: ($rows[1:] | map([$rows[0], .] | transpose | map({(.[0]): .[1]}) | add))}' "$S/channels.tsv" > "$S/summary.json" || exit 6
( cd "$S" && sha256sum -- *.tsv summary.json > SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6

# Identity guard, fail closed: fixed patterns plus every account handle and git author string seen in the raw data.
{ jq -r '.. | objects | (.login? // empty), (select(has("email")) | .name? // empty)' "$R"/*.json 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' "${REPO%%/*}"; } | awk 'length >= 3' | sort -u > "$R/ids.txt"
guard() { ! grep -rIlE '@|login|avatar_url|html_url|name"' -- "$1" && ! grep -rIlwF -f "$R/ids.txt" -- "$1"; }
guard "$S" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED: nothing written to OUT" >&2; exit 5; }
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" && cp -- "$S"/* "$OUT"/ || exit 6
guard "$OUT" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED on OUT: quarantine $OUT by hand" >&2; exit 5; }
( cd "$OUT" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6
echo "mode=$MODE calls=$N/$BUDGET budget_hit=$HIT"
[ "$HIT" = 1 ] && exit 4
exit 0

1	# Review of Protocol C (`PROTOCOL-C.md`, `scope_c.sh`)
2	
3	Basis: `REVIEW-TASK.md`, `TASK.md`, `PROTOCOL-C.md` and `scope_c.sh` (read line by line). Nothing was run.
4	
5	## Verdict: **FAIL**
6	
7	There are three blocking issues, all under item 5 (forced negatives). Each one turns a non-200 response, or a call that was never made, into a negative-looking result in OUT. The most likely trigger is the expected run mode: `gh` is unauthenticated per ENVIRONMENT, so the script falls back to curl at 60 calls/h. In that mode, protection is *expected* to be NOT_ACCESSIBLE, and running twice in an hour returns 403s. Items 1–4, 6 and 7 pass, with some non-blocking limitations.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 1. Read-only on the host: OK
12	
13	There are two transport lines, and both are inside `get()`:
14	- L38: `gh api -X GET -i`
15	- L40: `curl -sS -X GET`
16	
17	`get()` is the only path to the network. Every call goes through it:
18	
19	| Line | Key | Method | Endpoint |
20	|---|---|---|---|
21	| 173 | probe_gh | GET (gh) | `rate_limit` |
22	| 174 | probe_curl | GET (curl) | `rate_limit` (only if curl mode) |
23	| 177 | repo | GET | `repos/REPO` |
24	| 62 | commit | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}` |
25	| 71 | pulls | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/pulls?per_page=5` |
26	| 78 | pr{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/pulls/{n}` (≤5×) |
27	| 79 | rv{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/pulls/{n}/reviews?per_page=100` (≤5×) |
28	| 80 | tl{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/issues/{n}/timeline?per_page=100` (≤5×) |
29	| 105 | checks | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100` |
30	| 115 | status | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/status` |
31	| 121 | runs | GET | `repos/REPO/actions/runs?head_sha={sha}&per_page=100` |
32	| 135 | prot | GET | `repos/REPO/branches/{base}/protection` |
33	| 144 | brules | GET | `repos/REPO/rules/branches/{base}?per_page=100` |
34	| 147 | rsets | GET | `repos/REPO/rulesets?per_page=100&includes_parents=true` |
35	| 156 | ev{p} | GET | `repos/REPO/events?per_page=100&page={1..3}` |
36	
37	- No method other than GET is used.
38	- No `-f`/`-F` body is sent.
39	- No `--paginate` is used.
40	- No other `gh` subcommand is called.
41	- No token is read, printed or written:
42	  - curl sends no auth header.
43	  - `gh api -i` captures only *response* headers, and those go to `$TMP/raw`.
44	  - stderr of both tools goes to `/dev/null`.
45	
46	## 2. Bound: OK
47	
48	- Repository and commit are hard-coded (L8).
49	- PRs are capped twice: by `per_page=5` and by `.[:5]` (L71–72).
50	- There is one base branch (L129).
51	- The window is a constant, used only as a filter.
52	- Reviews and timeline fetch one page each.
53	- Events fetch at most 3 pages, with three stop rules (L155–159).
54	- There is no search.
55	
56	The worst case is 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 15 + 3 + 3 + 3 = **29** calls, under BUDGET = 40. The budget check at L35 is a hard refusal before `N++`. No path can exceed the bound. The budget-hit path (exit 4) cannot be reached in practice.
57	
58	## 3. Identity: OK
59	
60	- **What reaches OUT.** Only derived fields: counts, booleans, `NOT_DETERMINABLE`, host and git timestamps, PR numbers, `base_ref`, event and type tallies, ruleset ids, target and enforcement, and endpoints with `REPO` substituted (L43). Logins, names, e-mails, avatars and URLs are never selected into the staged files. Role logins (`CA`, `PA`) live only in shell variables and jq `--arg`.
61	- **Raw responses** are written only under `$TMP/raw` (L29, L38–42), inside a `mktemp -d` directory with umask 077. `ids.txt` is also kept in TMP.
62	- **The guard fails closed.**
63	  - `! grep …`: a grep error (exit 2) also counts as a guard failure.
64	  - The fixed patterns, and every login, plus every name found in any object that has an `email` key, plus the owner slug, are matched as whole words against the *staged* directory before any copy (L193–196). The guard runs again on OUT (L198), followed by `sha256sum -c` (L199).
65	  - A guard hit exits 5 and nothing is written.
66	
67	## 4. Determinism and local safety: OK
68	
69	- `LC_ALL=C` and `TZ=UTC` are exported first (L7).
70	- Sorting is explicit: jq `sort`/`group_by`/`unique`/`sort_by(.id)`, and `sort -u`.
71	- `SELF` is resolved at L6. The script never `cd`s in the main shell; both `cd`s are in subshells (L190, L199).
72	- OUT is refused if it exists, lies under WORKTREE_DIR, or lies in any git work tree (L23–24). TMP gets the same check (L28).
73	- `rm -rf` runs only on `$TMP`, and only after its basename matches `scope_c.????????` (L26).
74	- There is no `set -e`. Exit codes are 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 0, all explicit.
75	
76	## 5. Reachability / no forced negative: **FAIL**
77	
78	How each existence value can be produced, per channel, as the script stands:
79	
80	| Channel | EXISTS | NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST | NOT_ACCESSIBLE | NOT_RETAINED |
81	|---|---|---|---|---|
82	| repository | yes | no (by design: a 200 means it exists) | yes | n/a |
83	| commit | yes | no (non-200 → NA, conservative) | yes | n/a |
84	| prs | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
85	| reviews | yes | yes, **also wrongly** (B1) | yes | n/a |
86	| timeline | yes | yes, **also wrongly** (B1) | yes | n/a |
87	| checks | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
88	| status | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
89	| runs | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
90	| protection | yes | yes (404 "Branch not protected"); **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
91	| branch_rules | yes | yes; **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
92	| rulesets | yes | yes; **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
93	| events | yes | yes | yes | yes |
94	
95	**Norm state and independence** are hard-coded to `NOT_DETERMINABLE` and `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE` in `row()` (L49). Neither is ever inferred from a check, a merge or a review. **Timestamp-generator labels** match the protocol table field by field. See N6 for one small gap.
96	
97	### Blocking issues
98	
99	**B1: A failed PR association is reported as "no associated PR". (L96–98, L129–132)**
100	
101	`npr` is 0 whenever `pulls` is not a usable 200. That covers a 403 (rate limit), a 404, a 422, `000` (transport failure), and a parse failure that gets replaced by `{}`. `base` is also empty whenever the lowest-numbered PR's `pulls/{n}` GET failed, because that row's `base_ref` is then `""`.
102	
103	In those cases, five channels are written as `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST` with the note "not called: no associated PR": reviews, timeline, protection, branch_rules and rulesets.
104	
105	Example: in curl mode, a second run within the hour gets a 403 on `commits/{sha}/pulls`. The result is `prs=NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, but reviews, timeline, protection, branch_rules and rulesets all show `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST`. That is a 403 mislabelled as absence.
106	
107	*Fix:*
108	- Take the "no PR" branch only when `st pulls` is 200 and `npr` is 0.
109	- Take the "no base" branch only when the lowest PR's GET is 200 and `base_ref` is empty.
110	- In every other case write `NOT_ACCESSIBLE` with the upstream status in `note`.
111	
112	**B2: Channels that were never called are labelled `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST`. (L132; PROTOCOL-C §2, special case 2)**
113	
114	The protocol contradicts itself. Its existence rule says "not called → NOT_ACCESSIBLE". Its special case says base-branch channels get `NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST` when there is no PR.

# Review of Protocol C (`PROTOCOL-C.md`, `scope_c.sh`)

Basis: `REVIEW-TASK.md`, `TASK.md`, `PROTOCOL-C.md` and `scope_c.sh` (read line by line). Nothing was run.

## Verdict: **FAIL**

There are three blocking issues, all under item 5 (forced negatives). Each one turns a non-200 response, or a call that was never made, into a negative-looking result in OUT. The most likely trigger is the expected run mode: `gh` is unauthenticated per ENVIRONMENT, so the script falls back to curl at 60 calls/h. In that mode, protection is *expected* to be NOT_ACCESSIBLE, and running twice in an hour returns 403s. Items 1–4, 6 and 7 pass, with some non-blocking limitations.

---

## 1. Read-only on the host: OK

There are two transport lines, and both are inside `get()`:
- L38: `gh api -X GET -i`
- L40: `curl -sS -X GET`

`get()` is the only path to the network. Every call goes through it:

| Line | Key | Method | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| 173 | probe_gh | GET (gh) | `rate_limit` |
| 174 | probe_curl | GET (curl) | `rate_limit` (only if curl mode) |
| 177 | repo | GET | `repos/REPO` |
| 62 | commit | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}` |
| 71 | pulls | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/pulls?per_page=5` |
| 78 | pr{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/pulls/{n}` (≤5×) |
| 79 | rv{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/pulls/{n}/reviews?per_page=100` (≤5×) |
| 80 | tl{n} | GET | `repos/REPO/issues/{n}/timeline?per_page=100` (≤5×) |
| 105 | checks | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/check-runs?per_page=100` |
| 115 | status | GET | `repos/REPO/commits/{sha}/status` |
| 121 | runs | GET | `repos/REPO/actions/runs?head_sha={sha}&per_page=100` |
| 135 | prot | GET | `repos/REPO/branches/{base}/protection` |
| 144 | brules | GET | `repos/REPO/rules/branches/{base}?per_page=100` |
| 147 | rsets | GET | `repos/REPO/rulesets?per_page=100&includes_parents=true` |
| 156 | ev{p} | GET | `repos/REPO/events?per_page=100&page={1..3}` |

- No method other than GET is used.
- No `-f`/`-F` body is sent.
- No `--paginate` is used.
- No other `gh` subcommand is called.
- No token is read, printed or written:
  - curl sends no auth header.
  - `gh api -i` captures only *response* headers, and those go to `$TMP/raw`.
  - stderr of both tools goes to `/dev/null`.

## 2. Bound: OK

- Repository and commit are hard-coded (L8).
- PRs are capped twice: by `per_page=5` and by `.[:5]` (L71–72).
- There is one base branch (L129).
- The window is a constant, used only as a filter.
- Reviews and timeline fetch one page each.
- Events fetch at most 3 pages, with three stop rules (L155–159).
- There is no search.

The worst case is 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 15 + 3 + 3 + 3 = **29** calls, under BUDGET = 40. The budget check at L35 is a hard refusal before `N++`. No path can exceed the bound. The budget-hit path (exit 4) cannot be reached in practice.

## 3. Identity: OK

- **What reaches OUT.** Only derived fields: counts, booleans, `NOT_DETERMINABLE`, host and git timestamps, PR numbers, `base_ref`, event and type tallies, ruleset ids, target and enforcement, and endpoints with `REPO` substituted (L43). Logins, names, e-mails, avatars and URLs are never selected into the staged files. Role logins (`CA`, `PA`) live only in shell variables and jq `--arg`.
- **Raw responses** are written only under `$TMP/raw` (L29, L38–42), inside a `mktemp -d` directory with umask 077. `ids.txt` is also kept in TMP.
- **The guard fails closed.**
  - `! grep …`: a grep error (exit 2) also counts as a guard failure.
  - The fixed patterns, and every login, plus every name found in any object that has an `email` key, plus the owner slug, are matched as whole words against the *staged* directory before any copy (L193–196). The guard runs again on OUT (L198), followed by `sha256sum -c` (L199).
  - A guard hit exits 5 and nothing is written.

## 4. Determinism and local safety: OK

- `LC_ALL=C` and `TZ=UTC` are exported first (L7).
- Sorting is explicit: jq `sort`/`group_by`/`unique`/`sort_by(.id)`, and `sort -u`.
- `SELF` is resolved at L6. The script never `cd`s in the main shell; both `cd`s are in subshells (L190, L199).
- OUT is refused if it exists, lies under WORKTREE_DIR, or lies in any git work tree (L23–24). TMP gets the same check (L28).
- `rm -rf` runs only on `$TMP`, and only after its basename matches `scope_c.????????` (L26).
- There is no `set -e`. Exit codes are 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 0, all explicit.

## 5. Reachability / no forced negative: **FAIL**

How each existence value can be produced, per channel, as the script stands:

| Channel | EXISTS | NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST | NOT_ACCESSIBLE | NOT_RETAINED |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| repository | yes | no (by design: a 200 means it exists) | yes | n/a |
| commit | yes | no (non-200 → NA, conservative) | yes | n/a |
| prs | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
| reviews | yes | yes, **also wrongly** (B1) | yes | n/a |
| timeline | yes | yes, **also wrongly** (B1) | yes | n/a |
| checks | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
| status | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
| runs | yes | yes | yes | n/a |
| protection | yes | yes (404 "Branch not protected"); **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
| branch_rules | yes | yes; **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
| rulesets | yes | yes; **also wrongly** (B1, B2) | yes | n/a |
| events | yes | yes | yes | yes |

**Norm state and independence** are hard-coded to `NOT_DETERMINABLE` and `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE` in `row()` (L49). Neither is ever inferred from a check, a merge or a review. **Timestamp-generator labels** match the protocol table field by field. See N6 for one small gap.

### Blocking issues

**B1: A failed PR association is reported as "no associated PR". (L96–98, L129–132)**

`npr` is 0 whenever `pulls` is not a usable 200. That covers a 403 (rate limit), a 404, a 422, `000` (transport failure), and a parse failure that gets replaced by `{}`. `base` is also empty whenever the lowest-numbered PR's `pulls/{n}` GET failed, because that row's `base_ref` is then `""`.

- Take the "no PR" branch only when `st pulls` is 200 and `npr` is 0.
- Take the "no base" branch only when the lowest PR's GET is 200 and `base_ref` is empty.
- In every other case write `NOT_ACCESSIBLE` with the upstream status in `note`.

## 6. M-TIME: OK, with a limitation

The three kinds of time are kept apart:
- **Decision time** `t` and the window are constants (L9).

## 7. Neutrality: OK

- There is no hypothesis, conformance test or score.
- Retention is stated as "assumed (unchecked)".
- `n_approvals_le_t` and `updated_le_t` are recorded without interpretation.

---

1	# The scoping questions (human decision record, verbatim intent)
2	**Goal:** does an independent record exist that could establish **which norm (ruling / authorization) was in force at a given time**? "Independent" means maintained by someone or something other than (a) the norm-maker, (b) the executor of the work, and (c) the ruling that asserts its own effectiveness.

4	For each candidate channel, answer only:
5	1. Does it exist?
6	2. What does it record?

**Goal:** does an independent record exist that could establish **which norm (ruling / authorization) was in force at a given time**? "Independent" means maintained by someone or something other than (a) the norm-maker, (b) the executor of the work, and (c) the ruling that asserts its own effectiveness.

1. Does it exist?
2. What does it record?

5. Can it establish the norm in force at time t?
6. How complete is it?
7. How independent is it?

- Existence or scoping only; **no broad archaeology**; do not acquire the underlying evidence yet.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_c.sh: Protocol C r1 (PROTOCOL-C.md). Bounded, read-only (HTTP GET only) host-side scoping of one commit.
# Raw responses stay in a private temp dir; only identity-free derived fields reach OUT.
# Usage: scope_c.sh OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR
# Exit: 0 ok | 2 precondition | 3 refused path | 4 budget hit (partial output) | 5 identity guard | 6 write failure
SELF="$(readlink -f -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" || exit 2   # resolved before any cd
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC; umask 077
REPO="dr-roshyara/nrna1"; SHA="e4724a444231681f1a455ffaeea488a554183093"
T0="2026-08-04T00:30:25Z"; WF="2026-08-03T00:00:00Z"; WE="2026-08-06T00:00:00Z"
BUDGET=40; PR_CAP=5; EV_PAGES=3; API="https://api.github.com"
CHANNELS="commit prs reviews timeline checks status runs protection branch_rules rulesets events"
DOC422="commit"   # channels whose endpoint documents 422 (PROTOCOL-C §2; assumption to check)

[ $# -eq 2 ] || { echo "usage: ${SELF##*/} OUT_DIR WORKTREE_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
for t in jq curl git date sha256sum readlink mktemp awk grep cut wc head tr sort; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "refused: '$t' not found" >&2; exit 2; }; done
WTREE="$(readlink -f -- "$2")"
[ -n "$WTREE" ] && [ -d "$WTREE" ] || { echo "refused: WORKTREE_DIR is not a directory" >&2; exit 2; }
OUT="$(readlink -m -- "$1")"
inside() {   # PATH under WORKTREE_DIR, or its nearest existing ancestor inside any git work tree (git is required)
  case "$1/" in "$WTREE"/*) return 0 ;; esac
  local a="$1"; while [ ! -d "$a" ]; do a="${a%/*}"; [ -n "$a" ] || a=/; done
  git -C "$a" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; }
[ -e "$OUT" ] && { echo "refused: OUT exists (no overwrite)" >&2; exit 3; }
inside "$OUT" && { echo "refused: OUT is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
TMP="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/scope_c.XXXXXXXX")" || exit 6
cleanup() { case "${TMP##*/}" in scope_c.????????) [ -d "$TMP" ] && rm -rf -- "$TMP" ;; esac; }
trap cleanup EXIT
inside "$TMP" && { echo "refused: TMPDIR is inside a work tree" >&2; exit 3; }
R="$TMP/raw"; S="$TMP/stage"; mkdir "$R" "$S" || exit 6

N=0; HIT=0; MODE=curl; HD_FIRST=""; HD_LAST=""; CT_FIRST=""; CT_LAST=""
printf 'seq\tchannel\tendpoint\thttp_status\n' > "$S/calls.tsv"
get() {   # get KEY CHANNEL PATH: one GET -> $R/KEY.{json,status,hdr}; once the budget is spent: no call, status "budget", returns 1
  local k="$1" p="$3" s="" d h=(-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28")
  if [ "$N" -ge "$BUDGET" ]; then HIT=1; echo budget > "$R/$k.status"; echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"; return 1; fi
  N=$((N + 1)); CT_LAST="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; CT_FIRST="${CT_FIRST:-$CT_LAST}"
  if [ "$MODE" = gh ]; then
    gh api -X GET -i "${h[@]}" "$p" > "$R/$k.http" 2>/dev/null
    s="$(head -n1 "$R/$k.http" | awk '{print $2}')"; awk 'b{print; next} /^\r?$/{b=1}' "$R/$k.http" > "$R/$k.json"
    awk '/^\r?$/{exit} {print}' "$R/$k.http" > "$R/$k.hdr"
  else s="$(curl -sS -X GET -D "$R/$k.hdr" -o "$R/$k.json" -w '%{http_code}' "${h[@]}" "$API/$p" 2>/dev/null)"; fi
  s="${s:-000}"
  jq -e . "$R/$k.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{}' > "$R/$k.json"; [ "$s" = 200 ] && s=200_unparsable; }
  echo "$s" > "$R/$k.status"
  d="$(grep -i -m1 '^date:' "$R/$k.hdr" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f2- | tr -d '\r')"
  [ -n "$d" ] && { HD_LAST="$d"; HD_FIRST="${HD_FIRST:-$d}"; }
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$N" "$2" "${p//"$REPO"/REPO}" "$s" >> "$S/calls.tsv"; }
st() { cat "$R/$1.status" 2>/dev/null || echo 000; }
agg() { local s; [ -n "$1" ] || { echo 000; return; }; for s in ${1//,/ }; do [ "$s" = 200 ] || { echo "$s"; return; }; done; echo 200; }
lab() {   # lab STATUS COUNT CHANNEL: existence label under the one status-gating rule (PROTOCOL-C §2)
  case "$1" in
    200) if [ "${2:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo EXISTS; else echo NOT_EVIDENCED_ON_HOST; fi ;;
    401|403|404) echo NOT_ACCESSIBLE ;;
    422) case " $DOC422 " in *" $3 "*) echo NOT_ACCESSIBLE ;; *) echo "NOT_ACCESSIBLE[transport]" ;; esac ;;
    budget) echo "NOT_ACCESSIBLE[not_called_budget]" ;;
    *) echo "NOT_ACCESSIBLE[transport]" ;;
  esac; }
why() { case "$1" in budget) echo "not called: call budget reached" ;; 000) echo "transport failure (000)" ;; *) echo "http $1" ;; esac; }
dep() { if [ "$1" = budget ]; then echo "NOT_ACCESSIBLE[not_called_budget]"; else echo "NOT_ACCESSIBLE[dependency_failed]"; fi; }
printf 'channel\thttp\texistence\tts_generator\tnorm_state_at_t\tindependence\tnote\n' > "$S/channels.tsv"
row() { printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\tNOT_DETERMINABLE\tINDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE\t%s\n' "$@" >> "$S/channels.tsv"; }
crow() {   # crow CH STATUS[,STATUS..] COUNT TS_GENERATOR NOTE: a non-200 note leads with its actual cause
  local s; s="$(agg "$2")"
  row "$1" "$2" "$(lab "$s" "$3" "$1")" "$4" "$([ "$s" = 200 ] || printf '%s; ' "$(why "$s")")$5"; }
kv() {   # kv CH STATUS < key\tvalue lines: every derived value becomes NA unless STATUS is 200
  local f="$S/ch_$1.tsv"; [ -e "$f" ] || printf 'key\tvalue\nhttp\t%s\n' "$2" > "$f"
  awk -F'\t' -v s="$2" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} s != "200" && $1 != "scope" && $1 != "n_distinct_bases" {$2 = "NA"} {print}' >> "$f"; }
kvget() { awk -F'\t' -v k="$2" '$1==k{print $2}' "$S/ch_$1.tsv" 2>/dev/null; }
JQD='def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
def inw: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x >= $wf and $x < $we;
def le_t: (. // "") as $x | $x != "" and $x <= $t;
def eq(a; b): if (a // "") == "" or (b // "") == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" elif a == b then "true" else "false" end;
def eqc(a): if $cs != "200" then "NA" else eq(a; $ca) end;
def cnt(f): if $cs != "200" then "NA" elif $ca == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else (map(select(f == $ca)) | length) end;
def g(s; v): if s == "200" then v else "NA" end;
def tally(f): map(f // "none" | tostring) | group_by(.) | map("\(.[0])=\(length)") | join(",");'
jqn() { local f="$1"; shift   # jqn FILTER [jq options]; $ca/$pa (roles) live only in memory; $cs = commit status
  jq -nr --arg ca "${CA:-}" --arg pa "${PA:-}" --arg cs "$(st commit)" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" "$@" "$JQD $f"; }

scan() {
  local s n npr ps cap=NA base s0 nb b c rv="" tl="" pst="" nrv ntl nc g p cc o es="" e1 nw ee
  local hist="current state only; historic state not available" nopr="not called: host lists no associated PR"
  local ttg="created_at=HOST_GENERATED; committed=CLIENT_SUPPLIED; no timestamp=NO_TIMESTAMP"
  get commit commit "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA"
  CA=""; [ "$(st commit)" = 200 ] && CA="$(jq -r '.author.login // empty' "$R/commit.json")"
  jqn '$x[0] | "identity_mapping_available\t\($ca != "")", "author_eq_committer\t\(eq(.author.login; .committer.login))",
    "author_date\t\(.commit.author.date // "")", "committer_date\t\(.commit.committer.date // "")",
    "signature_verified\t\(.commit.verification.verified | tostring)",
    "verification_reason\t\(.commit.verification.reason // "none")"' --slurpfile x "$R/commit.json" | kv commit "$(st commit)"
  crow commit "$(st commit)" 1 "author.date,committer.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "role mapping source only"
  jqn '$x[0] | "owner_eq_commit_author\t\(eqc(.owner.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository "$(st commit)"

  get pulls prs "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/pulls?per_page=$PR_CAP"; ps="$(st pulls)"; PRS=()
  [ "$ps" = 200 ] && mapfile -t PRS < <(jqn "\$x[0] | arr | map(.number) | sort | .[:$PR_CAP][]" --slurpfile x "$R/pulls.json")
  npr=${#PRS[@]}; [ "$ps" = 200 ] && { [ "$npr" -ge "$PR_CAP" ] && cap=true || cap=false; }
  printf 'pr\tpr_http\treviews_http\ttimeline_http\tstate\tmerged\tbase_ref\tcreated_at\tmerged_at\tmerged_le_t\tmerged_in_window\tpr_author_eq_commit_author\tmerger_eq_pr_author\tmerger_eq_commit_author\tn_reviews\tn_distinct_reviewers\tn_approvals\tn_approvals_le_t\tn_approvals_in_window\tn_approvals_by_pr_author\tn_approvals_by_commit_author\treviews_truncated\ttimeline_truncated\n' > "$S/prs.tsv"
  printf 'pr\thttp\tevent\tn\tn_timestamped\tn_in_window\tn_no_timestamp\tts_generator\n' > "$S/timeline.tsv"
  for n in "${PRS[@]}"; do
    get "pr$n" prs "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n"; get "rv$n" reviews "repos/$REPO/pulls/$n/reviews?per_page=100"
    get "tl$n" timeline "repos/$REPO/issues/$n/timeline?per_page=100"
    pst="$pst${pst:+,}$(st "pr$n")"; rv="$rv${rv:+,}$(st "rv$n")"; tl="$tl${tl:+,}$(st "tl$n")"
    PA=""; [ "$(st "pr$n")" = 200 ] && PA="$(jq -r '.user.login // empty' "$R/pr$n.json")"
    jqn '($p[0]) as $p | ($v[0] | arr) as $v | ($l[0] | arr) as $l | ($v | map(select(.state == "APPROVED"))) as $a |
      [$n, $ps, $vs, $ls, g($ps; $p.state), g($ps; $p.merged_at != null), g($ps; $p.base.ref // ""), g($ps; $p.created_at),
       g($ps; $p.merged_at // ""), g($ps; $p.merged_at | le_t), g($ps; $p.merged_at | inw), g($ps; eqc($pa)),
       g($ps; eq($p.merged_by.login; $pa)), g($ps; eqc($p.merged_by.login)),
       g($vs; $v | length), g($vs; $v | map(.user.login) | unique | length), g($vs; $a | length),
       g($vs; $a | map(select(.submitted_at | le_t)) | length), g($vs; $a | map(select(.submitted_at | inw)) | length),
       g($ps; g($vs; if $pa == "" then "NOT_DETERMINABLE" else ($a | map(select(.user.login == $pa)) | length) end)),
       g($vs; $a | cnt(.user.login)), g($vs; ($v | length) >= 100), g($ls; ($l | length) >= 100)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' \
      --arg n "$n" --arg ps "$(st "pr$n")" --arg vs "$(st "rv$n")" --arg ls "$(st "tl$n")" \
      --slurpfile p "$R/pr$n.json" --slurpfile v "$R/rv$n.json" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/prs.tsv"
    if [ "$(st "tl$n")" = 200 ]; then   # per-event timestamp field; events without one are NO_TIMESTAMP, never HOST_GENERATED
      jqn '$l[0] | arr | group_by(.event) | .[] | .[0].event as $e |
        (if $e == "committed" then "author.date" elif $e == "reviewed" then "submitted_at" else "created_at" end) as $f |
        (map(if $e == "committed" then .author.date elif $e == "reviewed" then .submitted_at else .created_at end)
         | map(select(. != null and . != ""))) as $h |
        [$n, "200", $e, length, ($h | length), ($h | map(select(inw)) | length), (length - ($h | length)),
         (if ($h | length) == 0 then "NO_TIMESTAMP" elif $e == "committed" then "author.date=CLIENT_SUPPLIED"
          else "\($f)=HOST_GENERATED" end)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --arg n "$n" --slurpfile l "$R/tl$n.json" >> "$S/timeline.tsv"
    else printf '%s\t%s\tNA\tNA\tNA\tNA\tNA\tNA\n' "$n" "$(st "tl$n")" >> "$S/timeline.tsv"; fi
    [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && break
  done
  PA=""; nrv="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$15} END{print s+0}' "$S/prs.tsv")"; ntl="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1{s+=$4} END{print s+0}' "$S/timeline.tsv")"
  crow prs "$ps" "$npr" "created_at,merged_at=HOST_GENERATED" "n=$([ "$ps" = 200 ] && echo "$npr" || echo NA); cap_reached=$cap; pr_http=${pst:-none}"
  if [ "$ps" = 200 ] && [ "$npr" -eq 0 ]; then
    row reviews - "NOT_APPLICABLE[no_associated_pr]" "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "$nopr"
    row timeline - "NOT_APPLICABLE[no_associated_pr]" "$ttg" "$nopr"
  elif [ "$ps" != 200 ]; then
    row reviews - "$(dep "$ps")" "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "not called: PR association lookup $(why "$ps")"
    row timeline - "$(dep "$ps")" "$ttg" "not called: PR association lookup $(why "$ps")"
  else
    crow reviews "$rv" "$nrv" "submitted_at=HOST_GENERATED" "$([ "$(agg "$rv")" = 200 ] && echo "n=$nrv; ")see prs.tsv"
    crow timeline "$tl" "$ntl" "$ttg" "$([ "$(agg "$tl")" = 200 ] && echo "n=$ntl; ")see timeline.tsv"
  fi

  get checks checks "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/check-runs?per_page=100"
  jqn '($x[0].check_runs | arr) as $r | ($x[0].total_count // 0) as $tc | "total_count\t\($tc)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
    "checks_truncated\t\(($r | length) >= 100 or $tc > ($r | length))", "ts_decision_scope\treturned_page",
    "n_app_github_actions\t\($r | map(select(.app.slug == "github-actions")) | length)",
    "n_started_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | le_t)) | length)",
    "n_started_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.started_at | inw)) | length)", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))"' \
    --slurpfile x "$R/checks.json" | kv checks "$(st checks)"
  nc="$(kvget checks n_returned)"; g=NOT_DETERMINABLE
  [ "$(st checks)" = 200 ] && [ "${nc:-0}" -gt 0 ] && [ "$nc" = "$(kvget checks n_app_github_actions)" ] && g=HOST_GENERATED
  crow checks "$(st checks)" "$nc" "started_at,completed_at=$g (returned page only)" "app-written; HOST_GENERATED only if every run on the returned page is by the host CI app"

  get status status "repos/$REPO/commits/$SHA/status?per_page=100"
  jqn '($x[0].statuses | arr) as $r | "state\t\($x[0].state // "none")", "total_count\t\($x[0].total_count // 0)",
    "n_created_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | le_t)) | length)", "n_created_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | inw)) | length)",
    "n_creator_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.creator.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/status.json" | kv status "$(st status)"
  crow status "$(st status)" "$(kvget status total_count)" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "latest status per context only"

  get runs runs "repos/$REPO/actions/runs?head_sha=$SHA&per_page=100"
  jqn '($x[0].workflow_runs | arr) as $r | ($x[0].total_count // 0) as $tc | "total_count\t\($tc)", "n_returned\t\($r | length)",
    "runs_truncated\t\(($r | length) >= 100 or $tc > ($r | length))",
    "n_created_le_t\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | le_t)) | length)", "n_created_in_window\t\($r | map(select(.created_at | inw)) | length)",
    "events\t\($r | tally(.event))", "conclusions\t\($r | tally(.conclusion))", "n_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.actor.login))",
    "n_triggering_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($r | cnt(.triggering_actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/runs.json" | kv runs "$(st runs)"
  crow runs "$(st runs)" "$(kvget runs total_count)" "created_at,run_started_at=HOST_GENERATED; head_commit.timestamp=CLIENT_SUPPLIED" "metadata only; logs not fetched"

  get rsets rulesets "repos/$REPO/rulesets?per_page=100&includes_parents=true"   # repository-scoped: always called
  jqn '$x[0] | arr | "n_rulesets\t\(length)", "rulesets_truncated\t\(length >= 100)"' --slurpfile x "$R/rsets.json" | kv rulesets "$(st rsets)"
  printf 'id\ttarget\tenforcement\tcreated_at\tupdated_at\tupdated_le_t\n' > "$S/rulesets.tsv"
  [ "$(st rsets)" = 200 ] && jqn '$x[0] | arr | sort_by(.id) | .[] | [.id, .target, .enforcement, (.created_at // ""), (.updated_at // ""),
    (.updated_at | le_t)] | map(tostring) | join("\t")' --slurpfile x "$R/rsets.json" >> "$S/rulesets.tsv"
  crow rulesets "$(st rsets)" "$(kvget rulesets n_rulesets)" "created_at,updated_at=HOST_GENERATED" "repository-scoped; $hist"

  nb="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $7!="" && $7!="NA"{print $7}' "$S/prs.tsv" | sort -u | wc -l)"
  if [ "$ps" = 200 ] && [ "$npr" -eq 0 ]; then
    for c in protection branch_rules; do row "$c" - "NOT_APPLICABLE[no_associated_pr]" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$nopr; does not show that the commit's branches are unprotected"; done
  else
    if [ "$ps" = 200 ]; then s0="$(st "pr${PRS[0]}")"; base="$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==2{print $7}' "$S/prs.tsv")"; cc="lowest PR GET"
    else s0="$ps"; base=""; cc="PR association lookup"; fi   # base branch of the lowest-numbered associated PR
    if [ "$s0" != 200 ] || [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = NA ]; then
      for c in protection branch_rules; do row "$c" - "$(dep "$s0")" NOT_DETERMINABLE "not called: base branch not derivable ($cc $(why "$s0"))"; done
    else
      b="$(jq -rn --arg b "$base" '$b | @uri')"
      get prot protection "repos/$REPO/branches/$b/protection"
      jqn '$x[0] | "scope\tCURRENT_STATE_ONLY", "n_distinct_bases\t'"$nb"'", "required_pull_request_reviews\t\(.required_pull_request_reviews != null)",
        "required_approving_review_count\t\(.required_pull_request_reviews.required_approving_review_count // 0)",
        "enforce_admins\t\(.enforce_admins.enabled // false)", "required_status_checks\t\(.required_status_checks != null)",
        "required_signatures\t\(.required_signatures.enabled // false)", "push_restrictions\t\(.restrictions != null)",
        "allow_force_pushes\t\(.allow_force_pushes.enabled // false)"' --slurpfile x "$R/prot.json" | kv protection "$(st prot)"
      crow protection "$(st prot)" 1 NOT_DETERMINABLE "$hist"
      get brules branch_rules "repos/$REPO/rules/branches/$b?per_page=100"
      jqn '$x[0] | arr | "scope\tCURRENT_STATE_ONLY", "n_active_rules\t\(length)", "branch_rules_truncated\t\(length >= 100)",
        "types\t\(tally(.type))"' --slurpfile x "$R/brules.json" | kv branch_rules "$(st brules)"
      crow branch_rules "$(st brules)" "$(kvget branch_rules n_active_rules)" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$hist"
    fi
  fi

  for ((p = 1; p <= EV_PAGES; p++)); do   # page only while the window start has not been reached
    get "ev$p" events "repos/$REPO/events?per_page=100&page=$p"; es="$es${es:+,}$(st "ev$p")"
    [ "$(st "ev$p")" = 200 ] || break
    c="$(jq 'if type == "array" then length else 0 end' "$R/ev$p.json")"; o="$(jq -r '[.[]?.created_at?] | min // ""' "$R/ev$p.json")"
    [ "$c" -lt 100 ] && break; [[ "$o" < "$WF" ]] && break
  done
  e1="$(agg "$es")"
  jq -s '[.[] | if type == "array" then .[] else empty end]' "$R"/ev?.json > "$R/ev_all.json"
  jqn '($x[0] | arr) as $a | ($a | map(select(.created_at | inw))) as $w | ($a | map(.created_at) | min // "") as $o |
    "n_returned\t\($a | length)", "oldest_created_at\t\($o)", "newest_created_at\t\($a | map(.created_at) | max // "")",
    "window_covered\t\($o != "" and $o < $wf)", "n_in_window\t\($w | length)", "types_in_window\t\($w | tally(.type))",
    "n_in_window_actor_eq_commit_author\t\($w | cnt(.actor.login))"' --slurpfile x "$R/ev_all.json" | kv events "$e1"
  nw="$(kvget events n_in_window)"
  if [ "$e1" != 200 ]; then ee="$(lab "$e1" 0 events)"; elif [ "$(kvget events window_covered)" = true ]; then ee="$(lab 200 "$nw")"
  elif [ "${nw:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then ee=EXISTS; else ee=NOT_RETAINED; fi
  row events "$es" "$ee" "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "$([ "$e1" = 200 ] || printf '%s; ' "$(why "$e1")")retention assumed <=90 days and <=300 events (unchecked)"
}

if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE=gh; get probe_gh mode rate_limit; [ "$(st probe_gh)" = 200 ] || MODE=curl; fi
[ "$MODE" = curl ] && get probe_curl mode rate_limit
COVERAGE="authenticated"
[ "$MODE" = curl ] && COVERAGE="UNAUTHENTICATED: public repo only, 60 calls/h; protection needs admin and is expected NOT_ACCESSIBLE"
get repo repository "repos/$REPO"
jqn '$x[0] | "visibility\t\(.visibility // (if .private == true then "private" elif .private == false then "public" else "unknown" end))",
  "owner_type\t\(.owner.type // "unknown")", "created_at\t\(.created_at // "")"' --slurpfile x "$R/repo.json" | kv repository "$(st repo)"
crow repository "$(st repo)" 1 "created_at=HOST_GENERATED" "visibility=$(kvget repository visibility)"
[ "$(st repo)" = 200 ] && scan
L="$(dep "$(st repo)")"; WHY="not called: repository GET $(why "$(st repo)")"
[ "$HIT" = 1 ] && { L="NOT_ACCESSIBLE[not_called_budget]"; WHY="not called: call budget reached"; }
for c in $CHANNELS; do cut -f1 "$S/channels.tsv" | grep -qx "$c" || row "$c" - "$L" NOT_DETERMINABLE "$WHY"; done

jq -Rn --arg mode "$MODE" --arg cov "$COVERAGE" --arg sha "$SHA" --arg t "$T0" --arg wf "$WF" --arg we "$WE" \
  --arg rh "$(printf %s "$REPO" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)" --arg sh "$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -c1-64)" \
  --arg hf "$HD_FIRST" --arg hl "$HD_LAST" --arg cf "$CT_FIRST" --arg cl "$CT_LAST" \
  --argjson n "$N" --argjson bud "$BUDGET" --argjson hit "$HIT" \
  'def na: if . == "" then "NA" else . end; [inputs | split("\t")] as $rows |
   {protocol: "C", revision: "r1", mode: $mode, coverage: $cov, commit: $sha, repo_slug_sha256: $rh,
   script_sha256: $sh, t: $t, window: {from: $wf, to: $we}, calls: $n, budget: $bud, budget_hit: ($hit == 1),
   observation_time: {host_date_header: {first: ($hf | na), last: ($hl | na), generator: "HOST_GENERATED"},
                      client_clock_utc: {first: ($cf | na), last: ($cl | na), generator: "CLIENT_SUPPLIED"}},
   channels: ($rows[1:] | map([$rows[0], .] | transpose | map({(.[0]): .[1]}) | add))}' "$S/channels.tsv" > "$S/summary.json" || exit 6
( cd "$S" && sha256sum -- *.tsv summary.json > SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6

# Identity guard, fail closed: fixed patterns plus every account handle and git author string seen in the raw data.
# The script's own notes carry no product or proper names, so they cannot trip it.
{ jq -r '.. | objects | (.login? // empty), (select(has("email")) | .name? // empty)' "$R"/*.json 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' "${REPO%%/*}"; } | awk 'length >= 3' | sort -u > "$R/ids.txt"
guard() { ! grep -rIlE '@|login|avatar_url|html_url|name"' -- "$1" && ! grep -rIlwF -f "$R/ids.txt" -- "$1"; }
guard "$S" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED: nothing written to OUT" >&2; exit 5; }
mkdir -- "$OUT" || { echo "refused: cannot create OUT (it now exists, or its parent is missing)" >&2; exit 3; }
cp -- "$S"/* "$OUT"/ || exit 6
guard "$OUT" || { echo "IDENTITY GUARD FAILED on OUT: quarantine $OUT by hand" >&2; exit 5; }
( cd "$OUT" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS ) || exit 6
echo "mode=$MODE calls=$N/$BUDGET budget_hit=$HIT"
[ "$HIT" = 1 ] && exit 4
exit 0
